# PenX Windows release download guide (GitLab)

**No Windows binaries have been published on GitLab as of October 16, 2026.** Follow the [source installation instructions](../README.md#quick-start) until tested assets appear on [GitLab Releases](https://gitlab.com/SLP-DEV1/PenX/-/releases).

When published, select **PenX-Setup-x64.exe** for a standard Windows installation or **PenX-Windows-x64.zip** for a portable folder (keep the entire directory including `_internal`). Verify the matching `SHA256SUMS.txt` from that release. Automatic source code ZIP archives are **not** ready-to-run Windows apps.

Scanner binaries and local AI models are not bundled. See [WINDOWS.md](../WINDOWS.md) for installation and migration details.
